in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who brings happiness and joy.

in_marathi.name: Tanu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tanu is a Sanskrit name which means 'Jewel' or 'Delight'. In Hindu mythology, Tanu is the name of Lord Shiva's wife, Parvati, who is the goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. The name Tanu is believed to bring happiness, beauty, and grace to the one who bears it.
